lines.text: 🚨 White Noise, Cliffhanger, Murkcap, Sweeps Week, Flashbulb Moth is at Haven's door. The village looks to you. Four ways to call: a RUNNER (slow, dangerous), a SIGNAL FIRE (fast, loud, everyone sees), the SYSTEM RELAY (if it can carry voices), or an ABILITY CRY (if your build has one). Each with honest costs.
📓 Codex: White Noise, Cliffhanger, Murkcap, Sweeps Week, Flashbulb Moth at the door, day 8.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Murkcap: Stay out of the sporefall. The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Stay out of the sporefall — The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap.

💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Sweeps Week: Never show it your back. FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (Two survived encounters — the fire has a theory.)

📓 Codex: Counter: Never show it your back — FACE IT — or paint eyes on the back of your head — and it hesitates. It wants the ambush, not the fight. Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow.
🛡️ Eduardo, Miranda, Elif, Aroha and Sofia met them at the door — 4 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Eduardo, Miranda, Sofia are hurt.
One of them is coming for YOU — White Noise, inside the haven, eyes on your bedroll.
Days later, you'll hear what happened out past the ridge. For now: nothing. The village keeps its face still.
Riders on the ridge — no, a cart. A TRADER. Word travels: Haven has food, and where there's food there's trade.
📓 Codex: a weathered trader arrived (trader).
📢 SYSTEM CHALLENGE: "Catch something! Anything! We want to see how you do it!" (Hunt an animal today for a reward.)
Rain. Steady, cold, honest rain.
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
Village meal: +1147 kcal, +1L water from the communal pantry. (Half ration — they don't trust you yet.)
🩹 You make rounds — Miranda gets bound up properly. (44 → 59 HP)
Quiet mending sounds from the bunks — Hannah fixing something.

Elif has been asking about the strange leaves all week — "but what IS it?" Tonight, an answer. Ava is showing everyone Ghost Pipe by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
Hannah came back with 410 kcal of something edible. The pantry can't take it all — 205 kcal in, 205 kcal eaten at the fire.
Sofia and Miranda lingered over the fire together.
🍽️ Elif surveys the stacked shelves and nods. "The wild can rest. Splitting firewood instead — winter comes whether we like it or not."
🍽️ Vasyl watches another basket arrive and laughs. "We're feeding the shelves more than ourselves. Not today."
You've started noticing: Hannah and Paola never speak. It's not new. (Something old lives in Haven.)
— DAY 9 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
👀 Paola starts a story with "back when I was a pharmacist..." then corrects to something else mid-sentence. The correction is worse than the slip.
📓 Codex: A person, maybe 20s — jotted down what they said. Filed.

🔥 Nicole has been turning something over all evening. Finally: “Paola. The trade story — we all eat from the same pot here, we don’t get to lie about who’s at it.” It costs Nicole to say it; you can see the price land.
Elif Aktas reads the sky: frost tomorrow, cold.
Hunger gnaws. The pack is thin — work the green, haul it back, get it named at camp. That's the whole game.
You wake with a start — something is wrong.
◈ CRISIS — THE BREACH. It got INSIDE. The haven was supposed to be the safe place — the one place. It isn’t.
SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.
You don't know what that was. A heron that isn't quite there when you look at it. Someone at the haven should hear about this.
⚔ WHITE NOISE! You're on your own.
Turn-based now. Tap a tile to move — speed is squares. Then act.
(The game is telling you something: this is bigger than one person. Talk to your companions — "We should name this. Us.")
(heron's hide absorbs 1.)
You STRIKE the heron for 9.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
It unfolds further — impossibly tall. The air goes staticky; the creek goes flat. It has decided.
(heron's hide absorbs 1.)
You STRIKE the heron for 15.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
💥 It STRIKES — a needle out of the white noise!
Heron's attack hits you for 19.
📖 Codex: Spearfish Strike — strikes in a straight line. You won't forget this.
(heron's hide absorbs 1.)
heron is BLEEDING — and it likes it. Louder, faster, no more feints.
You STRIKE the heron for 14.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
(heron's hide absorbs 1.)
You STRIKE the heron for 15.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
You blink. It is somewhere else. You didn't see it move.
(heron's hide absorbs 1.)
You STRIKE the heron for 11.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
(heron's hide absorbs 1.)
The White Noise falls.
📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
You STRIKE the heron for 13.
📺 +5 style — solid hit
📺 +20 style — dropped the White Noise!

Fishy. Obviously. Everything about it is fishy. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
You came back bloody. Nobody asks. Someone saves you the good seat by the fire.

◈ "UNIT MIXTAPE — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Mixtape
Hand-labeled: 'FOR THE DRIVE.' No player. The songs are in your head anyway — you hum them when you work, and the work goes faster.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: You sing while you work. The work remembers the rhythm.
💛 The Mixtape is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)

◈ "UNIT DOG TAGS — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn (morale). You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Dog Tags
Not yours. Adrian's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Adrian would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Adrian taught you to read ground. You never forgot.
💛 The Dog Tags is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)

◈ "UNIT KNIFE ROLL — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn; camp cooking goes further. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Knife roll
The dinner rush, the pass, the tickets coming faster than thought. You survived your first Saturday service at sixteen. The roll was the prize.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: You can feed people. It is what you do.
💛 The Knife roll is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — quiet luck: 1 in 5 misses lands anyway, while worn.)
◈ "UNIT HOME KEY — [TRANSLATION COMPLETE] — we have been watching you carry this. Attachment waveform: significant. Function decoded: +resolve when worn. You knew it mattered before we did. Cute."

◈ FLASHBACK — Home key
The key never leaves your pocket. Locks are a promise: somewhere, a door still fits this.
📖 The memory leaves something behind: Home is a direction. You are walking it.
💛 The Home key is starting to do something. (Keepsake L1 — anchor: chasers tire faster when you flee, while worn.)
You clutch your Field suture kit, Mixtape, Dog Tags, Knife roll, Home key. You're still here.
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
You are full enough.
The pantry is in the hall. Your hands are not.
No risky water to boil.
Drank clean water.
Paola shakes their head. "Ask someone who trusts you." (Trust too low.)

🌿 Ava checks the pantry before heading out — the shelves are full, ~14 days of fresh on hand… leaves the harvest standing and turns to the wood run instead. The pantry can't take more; the wild will keep.
🪵 Ava hauls back 5 wood. The pile grows. (29 logs now.)
💧 Nicole returns with water: +2 clean.
Aroha heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
🚶 Hannah is back with Vasyl.
💧 Vasyl returns with water: +3 clean.
💧 Leo returns with water: +4 clean.
Someone's retelling it again — Miranda, out past the ridge. Elif says "Miranda would've gone farther if we'd let them."
Iron cold. Even the ticks are shelved.
— MIDDAY — Honest work hours. Heat builds.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
"You haven't earned that yet," Paola says. (Trust too low.)
You catch fragments by the fire — Paola telling Eduardo about Hannah. The retelling is already better than the event.
You catch fragments by the fire — Nicole telling Miranda about Hannah. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
You catch fragments by the fire — Eduardo telling Aroha about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
Word gets around the haven. Whatever that thing was — everyone's talking about it now.
Back at the haven the argument starts: Paola is calling it "Big Ugly." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.
Paola showed Hannah the Pedunculate Oak Acorn — "remember it." Word gets around.
Nicole heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
🩹 Miranda is hurting (62 HP) — You patch them up before they head out. (62 → 87 HP)
Miranda heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
Ava heads out for water. "The well won't fill itself."
📖 Eduardo is walking Elif through a small tree with white starry flowers in spring and clusters of red-to-purple berries in early summer — leaf, stem, smell, the beginner's tour.
— DUSK — Animals stir again. Shadows lengthen.
The door is quiet. Haven breathes.
◈ CRISIS — THE SIEGE. They came in the night for the pantry — and the village met them at the door with blades and fire and drove them back into the dark. Wealth has a scent. So does defiance.
SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."
🛟 Paola stands up by the fire. "We take the hit and we answer it — standing here isn't an answer. Here's what we CAN do — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Tend the hurt, stretch the food, or hunt it back — pick one, maybe two, but everything costs something."
"Or we rally," Paola adds. "Second shift, everybody. We work, we eat, we live — and we pay for it."
(Relief is open — triage, rations, hunt, or rally, from the beats row. Each option works once; the moment passes in ~3 days.)
📓 Codex: Paola proposed relief (raid), day 9.
You wait. The light changes. Nothing asks anything of you.
Paola looks at you flatly. "Why should I listen to you?" (Trust too low.)
The stash count is off. 1 stone missing. Nobody saw anything. Everybody suspects something.
You catch fragments by the fire — Paola telling Elif about Hannah. It's picking up decorations as it travels.
You catch fragments by the fire — Paola telling Hannah about you. The story's getting bigger than what happened.
